contentText: Iran's foreign minister said on Monday the Islamic republic is ready for both war and talks after repeated threats from US President Donald Trump to intervene militarily over a crackdown on protests that activists fear has killed hundreds. Trump has also said he would ask Elon Musk to send more Starlink satellite terminals to give protesters Internet access as the country undergoes an Internet shutdown. FRANCE 24's Kethevane Gorjestani looks at what the US could actually do.
